title: Embedding scale handling and metric-selection compatibility for rerank/embeddings endpoints
creator: Ava Ramirez
description:
Summary: Customers have observed inconsistent reranking results and integration bugs due to ambiguous embedding metric semantics (cosine vs dot) and inconsistent normalization handling between our hosted endpoint, SDKs, and vector stores. This ticket scopes a change to make metric selection explicit, provide a backward-compatible migration path, and reduce surprising quality regressions while minimizing latency impact.

Problem details:
- Historically our embeddings endpoint returned raw vectors and clients implicitly assumed either dot or cosine. Some SDKs (older Python client) normalized automatically; some customers normalized before indexing; some index stores (FAISS/Annoy) expect pre-normalized vectors.
- This ambiguity caused incorrect reranking when users mixed assumptions (e.g., using dot with non-normalized vectors when they expected cosine).
- We need to correct the server behavior and docs so metrics are explicit, produce a migration plan for existing customers, and add runtime guards to avoid silent quality regressions.

Goals:
1) Make metric selection explicit in the embeddings+rerank APIs (metric param with values: dot, cosine, l2). Default must preserve existing behavior for current customers unless opted in.
2) Provide a compatibility header and flag that preserves legacy behavior for 90 days while customers migrate.
3) Add a server-side normalize option that can be toggled per-request to support users who cannot change storage.
4) Update SDKs and docs with a clear migration guide and recommended best practices (store normalized vectors when using cosine).
5) Measure and bound latency/CPU impact; ensure <1ms median additional latency for normalization on typical request sizes.

Non-goals:
- For this ticket we will not change underlying vector store formats; multi-format storage (store raw+norm) is a follow-up.

Implementation approach:
- API: add optional query/body parameter "metric" (string) with allowed values "dot", "cosine", "l2" and an optional boolean "normalize". If "metric" is omitted, we will use current-legacy behavior unless the request sets header "X-Embedding-Compat: modern".
- Server: implement fast L2 normalization path using AVX/ARM Neon in the runtime hot path; reuse existing batching infrastructure to amortize normalization cost. Add a per-request flag that can short-circuit normalization when not needed.
- SDKs: add explicit metric and normalize flags in Python/JS clients, defaulting to legacy behavior. Ship SDK patch that warns on ambiguous use.
- Telemetry: log per-request metric selection and whether normalization was applied; surface distribution of similarity scores pre/post change in Console.
- Migration: provide a compatibility header "X-Embedding-Compat: legacy" to keep previous behavior for customers who need time to migrate. Deprecation schedule: 90-day opt-in window, then new default is "metric=cosine" for models marked as embedding-normalized in catalog (see model metadata).

Acceptance criteria:
- API schema updated and validated by contract tests.
- End-to-end reranking evaluation shows no regressions for legacy mode and measurable MAP@10 improvement (+2% on internal retrieval eval) when switching to explicit cosine for candidate sets collected with normalized vectors.
- Median added latency for 1k-dim embeddings when enabling server-side normalize is <1ms and p95 <3ms on our staging runtime.
updates: 2025-02-12 - Triage: Created ticket after multiple customer reports and SDK bug reports. Assigned to Noah. Added to embeddings-rerank-v2 project.

2025-02-18 - Design review: Proposed API parameter names (metric, normalize) and compatibility header. PM suggested defaulting to legacy to avoid breaking existing customers. Design/Docs owner (Maya Chen) flagged need for migration doc and example scripts.

2025-02-22 - Prototype: Implemented prototype normalization kernel in runtime. Microbenchmarks: normalization cost ~0.45ms median for 1536-d vectors on c5a.4xlarge equivalent. Added unit tests for orthogonal vectors and degenerate (zero) vectors.

2025-02-26 - Benchmarks: End-to-end rerank eval on internal devset (5k queries) shows MAP@10 +2.4% when using explicit cosine with normalized storage; dot on raw vectors matched baseline. Latency regression measured ~0.6ms median when server-side normalize enabled; memory overhead negligible. Dashboard PR created.
2025-03-01 - SDKs: Draft change for Python SDK to accept metric and normalize flags. Added deprecation warning for implicit normalization. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/198
2025-03-04 - Security review: no crypto/secret changes. Flagged to Security for audit of headers and telemetry. Security review required: true.
notes: Edge cases: zero vectors will be returned unchanged and normalization will set them to zero vector and we will treat similarity as 0 for cosine; documented behavior. We will add a migration notebook for major customers showing how to reindex with normalized embeddings. Follow-up ticket should evaluate storing both raw+normalized vectors to avoid reindexing.
